messages:
From: ops@neuronpay.com
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: sarah.tan@neuronpay.com
Date: 2026-09-14T08:17:00-07:00
Subject: Spike in 503s from EU region - immediate help needed

Hi Kimberly,

We started seeing a spike in 503s and increased token latencies for calls routed to eu-1 around 07:50 UTC. Error rate is ~6% for our live payment flow and our SLA is being breached. We rolled a quick retry client-side but that hasn't brought the rate down.

Can Redwood provide immediate guidance for an emergency reroute or regional override? We need:
- A short step-by-step we can apply now to send traffic to us-east as a temporary measure
- Any guidance on cache warming / KV cache impact and expected token cost change
- Evidence we can attach to our internal incident ticket (simple logs or a one-page runbook)

We can be on a quick bridge if you prefer—available now.

Thanks,
Sarah Tan
Senior SRE, NeuronPay
ops@neuronpay.com

(attachment: km-error-sample.log 12KB)

From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: ops@neuronpay.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, markus_klein@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-14T08:26:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Spike in 503s from EU region - immediate help needed

Hi Sarah — thanks for the alert and the log sample. We're looking into the eu-1 degradation now and I want to give you a safe, minimal-change path to keep your production flow healthy.

Immediate mitigation (recommended, <10 min to apply):
1) Region override header (temporary): set X-Redwood-Force-Region: us-east-1 on the client side for outbound requests. Example curl:
   curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <KEY>" -H "X-Redwood-Force-Region: us-east-1" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
2) TTL & retries: reduce client retry wait to 300ms and max retries to 2 while the override is active to avoid queuing.
3) Cache warming: trigger a small set of warmup requests for the most common prompts (see attached kv-cache-checklist.csv). This avoids cold-KV misses when switching regions.
4) Monitoring: watch 200/503 ratio and 95th pct latency for the next 20 min. If error rate remains >2% after override, notify us and we'll open a capacity burst lane.

Short answers to your specific asks:
- Expected token cost: ~5-12% increase due to cross-region egress and additional warmup requests.
- Evidence: attached redwood-zone-reroute-playbook-v2.pdf (one-page summary + curl examples) and we'll share an export of ingress metrics once the incident window closes.

I'll loop in Marissa (Customer Ops) and Markus (Infra) to coordinate the back-end remediation and follow-up packet. If you'd like a bridge now, we can do a quick 15-min call — tell us "now" or propose a time.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Head of Customer Success — Redwood Inference
(attachment: redwood-zone-reroute-playbook-v2.pdf)

From: aditya_rao@redwood.com

Date: 2026-09-14T08:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Spike in 503s from EU region - immediate help needed

Marissa / Markus — quick technical notes:
- KV cache: per-region. When NeuronPay flips X-Redwood-Force-Region to us-east-1 they're hitting cold KV for ~95% of keys we cache. Expect a brief latency spike for the first 200–500 requests per key.
- Backfill strategy: recommend client-side warmup set (we provided kv-cache-checklist.csv). On our side, we can pre-warm top 20 keys if NeuronPay shares the list (we've offered to do this during the maintenance window).
- Config toggle: we can enable "cross-region-kv-proxy" for 30 minutes to proxy KV reads back to eu-1 for hot keys to reduce misses — but that increases cross-region egress cost and could slightly increase p95 latency. I'll stand up the proxy for them if approved. ETA to enable: ~12 minutes.
- Root cause (prelim): transient disk IO saturation on a subset of eu-1 inference hosts; we're rebalancing and monitoring.

I'll enable the proxy on approval. Markus — can you confirm you can support a short-lived cross-region proxy and that we'll have metrics exports ready for NeuronPay's evidence?

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Staff Infrastructure Engineer, Redwood Inference

Subject: Post-incident: EU zone disruption — summary, evidence, next steps

Hi Sarah and NeuronPay team —

Thanks again for working with us during the EU region disruption. Below is a concise post-incident summary and the follow-up items we committed to:

What happened (TL;DR):
- Between 07:45–09:05 UTC on 2026-09-14, a subset of eu-1 inference hosts experienced transient IO saturation that caused increased 503s and elevated p95 latency for affected customers.

Immediate mitigations we executed:
- We advised NeuronPay to apply X-Redwood-Force-Region: us-east-1; this restored their success rate to >99% within 6 minutes.
- Redwood enabled a 30-minute cross-region KV proxy for NeuronPay's hot keys to reduce cold misses during the switch.
- Infra rebalanced load and removed the affected hosts from rotation; disk IO alarms have been adjusted.

Evidence attached and links:
- redwood-zone-reroute-playbook-v2.pdf (runbook we provided during the event)
- neuronpay-incident-pack.zip (sanitized request/response samples and ingress metrics)
- Export of 1-min success_rate and p95 latency (shared to your Drive): https://drive.google.com/file/d/1rJ_example_drive_link

Customer impact and cost note:
- Temporary token cost rise was ~8% for NeuronPay during the window (warmup + cross-region egress). We'll provide a line-item in your next invoice if desired.

Follow-ups / action items (owner / ETA):
- Redwood infra (Aditya): add an automated detection rule for IO saturation anomalies for eu-1 (ETA: 2026-09-21).
- Redwood ops (Marissa): provide a 1-page tailored runbook with exact CLI commands for NeuronPay's engineering playbook (ETA: 2026-09-17).
- NeuronPay (Sarah): share top-20 warm keys if you want Redwood to handle pre-warm in future events (optional).

If you would like a formal joint postmortem (90-minute review with logs and run-of-the-mill blameless analysis), we can schedule that for this week — suggest Wed 09/17 14:00 UTC or Thu 09/18 10:00 UTC.

Appreciate your patience and partnership here. Please let us know if there's anything else you need immediately.

Best regards,
Kimberly Park
Head of Customer Success — Redwood Inference
Cell: +1 (415) 555-0192
(attachments: redwood-zone-reroute-playbook-v2.pdf, neuronpay-incident-pack.zip)
